subject: Re: that invitation from yesterday (tiny hiccup)
text:
Hey,

So, following up on the invitation I sent because I still really want you over next Friday, and I think I made it sound way too official for a friendly hangout, which is not the vibe I was going for? The point is you should come, bring your partner if possible, and we can talk about the new client stuff without the whole vendor energy. I was thinking around seven, though I just remembered my upstairs neighbor suddenly scheduled some repair on their balcony for the same day and the contractor wants to arrive between six and eight, so if there’s dust or a weird ladder outside, I might be a bit scattered, but that doesn’t mean the plan is canceled. I’ll just keep the kitchen door locked and maybe hide a mop somewhere because if they need access to the outside faucet, they might knock, and I don’t want you thinking the apartment is on fire. I’ve been meaning to ask your opinion on a few of the onboarding docs, but we can also do that casually over food if you prefer. I’m trying not to make this sound like another meeting. It’s not. I just like your brain, and I also have some roasted chicken that will make absolutely no sense if it has to stay alone overnight. Anyway, if the contractor situation becomes a complete mess, I’ll send one of those panicked little messages right away. Sorry, I’m rambling. Please say yes?
